comparison.objective: Set a date stamp, ink it, and make one correct impression; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotate detented setting wheels and perform controlled stamping versus counterhold an adjustment screw while tightening a nut.
comparison.success_condition: Correct permanent date impression with no smear or extra press versus opening retained through repeated gripper cycles.
comparison.reason: Configure-then-apply is only an abstract similarity; the physical mechanism and verified result differ.
